abort.identity_providers_disabled: Signing in with identity providers is turned off. Add `type: oidc` to `auth_providers` in your configuration to use it.
abort.no_url_available: Home Assistant has no URL that the identity provider could redirect back to. Set up an internal or external URL in the network settings first.

error.invalid_config: The identity provider configuration is not valid.
error.invalid_discovery: The identity provider returned an invalid OpenID Connect configuration.
error.issuer_mismatch: The identity provider reported issuer `{reported_issuer}`, which does not match the entered issuer.

data_description.client_id: OAuth2 client ID from the identity provider.
data_description.client_secret: OAuth2 client secret from the identity provider. Leave empty for a public client using PKCE only.

reconfigure.description: Update the client credentials for `{issuer}`. The issuer cannot be changed because it identifies the linked accounts. Changing the client ID breaks linked accounts if the identity provider issues pairwise subject identifiers.

data_description.client_id: OAuth2 client ID from the identity provider.
data_description.client_secret: OAuth2 client secret from the identity provider. Leave empty for a public client using PKCE only.
data_description.issuer: OpenID Connect issuer URL. The discovery document is loaded from `/.well-known/openid-configuration` below this URL.
